usermeta.purpose: Visualizes 25-year total farm business profit trends ($ AUD) across Australian agricultural sectors from 2000 to 2024.
usermeta.chartType: Multi-Line Trend Chart with Point Markers
usermeta.dataRequirements: Requires 'Year', 'Sector or industry', 'Average_Profit_Per_Farm_AUD', and 'Total_Profit_Sum_AUD' fields in australia_farm_profit_by_sector_2000_2024.csv.

title: 2000–2024 Australian Farm Business Profit Trends by Sector

data._comment: Loads 25-year sector-by-sector farm business profit CSV dataset

transform._comment: Filters out the 'All Broadacre' national aggregate to focus strictly on individual industry sectors
